import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSVs with index_col=0 as instructed
source_0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_32/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source_1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_32/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source_2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_32/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source_3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_32/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source_4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_32/training_4.csv", index_col=0)
source_5 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_32/training_5.csv", index_col=0)
source_6 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_32/training_6.csv", index_col=0)
source_7 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_32/training_7.csv", index_col=0)
source_8 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_32/training_8.csv", index_col=0)
source_9 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_32/training_9.csv", index_col=0)

# Step 1: UNION the four sources with the same schema (source_5,6,7,8)
union_5_6_7_8 = pd.concat([source_5, source_6, source_7, source_8], ignore_index=True)

# Step 2: JOIN union_5_6_7_8 with source_0 on ROW_WID
join_1 = pd.merge(union_5_6_7_8, source_0, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Step 3: JOIN with source_1 on ROW_WID
join_2 = pd.merge(join_1, source_1, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Step 4: JOIN with source_2 on ROW_WID
join_3 = pd.merge(join_2, source_2, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Step 5: JOIN with source_3 on ROW_WID
join_4 = pd.merge(join_3, source_3, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Step 6: JOIN with source_4 on ROW_WID
join_5 = pd.merge(join_4, source_4, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# Step 7: JOIN with source_9 on ROW_WID
join_6 = pd.merge(join_5, source_9, on="ROW_WID", how="inner")

# The target schema is only ['VISITS_NUM'], so we aggregate VISITS_NUM by sum (no group by)
# Because no key or group by columns exist in target, aggregate all rows into one sum
result = pd.DataFrame()
result["VISITS_NUM"] = [join_6["VISITS_NUM"].sum()]

# Write output
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length9_32/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
